shortDescription: The US generated 1.19 billion ethanol (D6) blending credits in September, down from 1.29 billion in August, according to Environmental Protection Agency data.Biodiesel blending credits (D4) rose to 788 million, from 716 million in August, according to the EPA.

children: The US generated 1.19 billion ethanol (D6) blending credits in September, down from 1.29 billion in August, according to Environmental Protection Agency data.
Biodiesel blending credits (D4) rose to 788 million, from 716 million in August, according to the EPA.
